case_title: TETYANA KOLESNIKOVA VS. CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $8,485.79 FILED BY KOLESNIKOVA, TETYANA AS TO DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-26-2023 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVICE FEE $100. SERVED MAR-07-2023, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) REMY WEILAND, CLAIMS ADJUSTER FILED BY DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO
STIPULATION TO ALLOW THE CASE TO BE HEARD BEFORE A JUDGE PRO TEM FILED BY KOLESNIKOVA, TETYANA CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-26-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO MAY-26-2023 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF TETYANA KOLESNIKOVA IS PRESENT WITH WITNESS OLEG GLADSHTEYN, HUSBAND. DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY REMY WEILAND, CLAIMS ADJUSTER. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $2000 TO THE PLAINTIFF (INCLUDES COSTS AND CONTINGENT UPON PLAINTIFF SIGNING THE CITY'S RELEASE OF LIABILITY). APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE MAY 26TH HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER TO CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)
